text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert 1775004321 - Streaming paths p95/p99 spike detected for /v1/stream (region: us-west). p95  -> 1.8s (baseline 0.22s), p99 -> 4.1s (baseline 0.6s). Error rate for streaming clients up 0.8%. Proxy timeouts (502/504) and repeated client disconnects observed. paging @oncall-erin :rotating_light:
oncall-erin: On it. grabbing logs, paging SRE. Anyone on streaming proxy today?
sre-jon: I see the same. Stack: front-proxy (nginx-h2) -> edge-router -> runtime pool. The proxy metrics show proxy_write_timeout spikes and output buffers backing up for connections with long idle periods. Collecting a sample of affected request ids: [r_3f1a2, r_3f1a3, r_3f1a7].
eng-lee: quick theory: slow consumers (mobile clients with flaky cellular) are filling proxy buffers which causes head-of-line blocking in the proxy and then triggers upstream backpressure. When the runtime tries to flush chunks, nginx holds due to http2 flow control and the kernel socket buffer is saturated. Also seeing increased keepalive close counts.
sre-jon: corroborating logs:
```
proxy_write_timeout after 60s waiting for client WINDOW_UPDATE
client slow consumer, bytes queued: 512k
```
can confirm proxy_send/recv timeouts hit.
eng-lee: mitigation plan (fast): 1) reduce nginx proxy_buffer_size and enable chunked transfer flush to avoid large buffer accumulation, 2) increase proxy_send_timeout to avoid premature 502s while flushing, 3) temporary route high-volume streaming clients to a new runtime pool with smaller per-connection buffer and aggressive drop policy.
sre-jon: I can flip a config for a quick experimental change. Suggest also enabling `proxy_ignore_client_abort on`? careful, that keeps resources busy. maybe better: enable `sendfile on; tcp_nodelay on;` and reduce `proxy_buffering` for streaming endpoints.
eng-lee: sample nginx snippets to try (canary):
```
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_http_version 1.1; # fall back for chunked flush if http2 stalls
  proxy_set_header Connection "";
  send_timeout 120s;
  proxy_send_timeout 120s;
  proxy_read_timeout 120s;
}
```
we should also add a route tag to send only 5% of traffic to the new pool first.
support-maya: Customer impact: support reported intermittent stream stalls for websocket clients and SSE reconnect loops. Top impacted customers: AcmePay (5% calls 00:10-00:40), EduLearn (1.2%), a few mobile apps. No billing cascade but UX degradation.
pm-sam: We should prepare an incident banner for the status page with a note about degraded streaming and ETA for fix ~30m. I'll draft after we confirm mitigation.
oncall-erin: Actioning immediate mitigations: 1) SRE will apply non-buffering for /v1/stream canary (5% traffic), 2) route other streaming traffic to fallback non-streaming poll endpoint for heavy clients, 3) eng runtime will push a small flush improvement to make chunks smaller. Please comment if you object.
sre-jon: Applying canary now. deploy-bot: starting config rollout to proxy-canary (id: cfg-1775004321)
deploy-bot: rollout 25% -> 50% -> 100% (canary policy). logs available at https://internal/logs/cfg-1775004321
eng-lee: pushing runtime change to reduce chunk size threshold from 64kb -> 8kb (this reduces per-client buffer requirement). small patch, will go to canary runtime pool.
support-maya: Noted, notifying the top 3 customers via private support channel. Will collect precise session ids and client platforms.
sre-jon: Early telemetry after canary: p95 for canaryed subset down to 260ms within 3m, overall cluster p95 trending down but still elevated due to remaining clients. proxy 502s down 70% for canary group.
oncall-erin: Good. escalating to incident severity 2. tagging postmortem owner. @eng-lee can you own root cause? @sre-jon run follow-up mitigation checklist and monitor SLOs.
eng-lee: I’ll drive RCA and follow-up changes: better client-side keepalive guidance, improve proxy backpressure metrics, and add a streaming-specific routing policy.
sre-jon: Monitoring: watch p95/p99, proxy_write_timeouts, kernel tx_queue length, and number of slow-consumer connections. Setting alert thresholds lower for next 48h.
pm-sam: Drafting status update now: "We're investigating degraded streaming performance (SSE/WebSocket) affecting a small subset of customers. Immediate mitigations deployed; partial recovery observed. Engineering continues to triage." Will post once Erin approves.
oncall-erin: Approve. post status.
sre-jon: Final note for oncall handoff: if regressions reappear route streaming traffic to fallback poll endpoint and open a page to oncall-sre. Handoff to morning SRE (oncall: pat) with these action items:
- RCA owner: eng-lee (postmortem)
- Follow-up: improve proxy metrics + deploy chunk-size change in prod
- Support: contact affected customers and provide incident timeline
- Perf: consider HTTP/2 window tuning or connection-level pacing

Thanks all — marking incident as "mitigated" for now, leaving in monitoring state. :thumbsup:
support-maya: adding list of affected accounts to the ticket and sending customer notes.
incident-bot: Incident 1775004321 status -> mitigated (monitored).
